title: Model-based editing
text: Every edit goes through an internal document model, not the browser's editing commands.

title: Full formatting set
text: Headings, emphasis, links, nested lists, quotes, code blocks, and alignment.

title: HTML and Markdown
text: Sanitized HTML and Markdown input and output, plus a plain-text mode.

title: Markdown shortcuts
text: Typing shortcuts such as a hash for headings or a dash for lists.

title: Configurable toolbar
text: Choose which toolbar items and heading levels authors can use.

title: Form control contract
text: Label, help text, length limits, counter, and localized validation like Textarea.
